'''Wicket33 Dark LSC, why not''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wicket33]]
* '''Published:''' 31 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Let Them Make The First Move
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 FirstMove Wicket33 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I have had some bad luck with dark deks, my last being a force-choke Hunt Down. Please help plug holes in this deck.

The published list has 66 cards.

== Strategy ==

To start, I know I have no space. I'm hoping my ground contingency can even out the odds. I use I WIll Find... to start if my opponent is playing fun on Theed objective. This helps Maul capture her highness and keep her from reaching her goal. Even temporarily setting back her conquest of Theed will help. In this area, any place to add Mauls will help. The non-starting Blaster Rack may be dropped (?) if I can't find reason to keep it. Aside from that, battle and drain on Theed. Any Questions?
